chemical_life_science_product_family.label: Chemical / life-science product family
chemical_life_science_product_family.value: Complex generics and biosimilars, pharmaceuticals distributed through AvKARE, and branded medicines for central nervous system and endocrine disorders.

specialty_commodity_positioning.label: Specialty / commodity positioning
specialty_commodity_positioning.value: Affordable complex generics and biosimilars, including injectables for hospitals and health systems, alongside branded specialty medicines.

formulation_synthesis_complexity.label: Formulation / synthesis complexity
formulation_synthesis_complexity.value: Complex dosage forms including injectables, topical and transdermal products, and metered-dose and dry-powder inhalers.

product_specific_regulatory_route.label: Product-specific regulatory route
product_specific_regulatory_route.value: U.S. FDA approval pathways for generics, biosimilars, and branded prescription medicines such as CREXONT.

r_d_intensity.label: R&D intensity
r_d_intensity.value: Global in-house R&D supporting increasingly complex generic dosage forms and U.S. commercialization.

clinical_commercialization_stage_pharma.label: Clinical / commercialization stage [pharma]
clinical_commercialization_stage_pharma.value: Commercial generics including hospital injectables, an expanding U.S. biosimilar business, and launched branded medicines including CREXONT and Brekiya.

biologic_small_molecule_platform_pharma.label: Biologic / small-molecule platform [pharma]
biologic_small_molecule_platform_pharma.value: Small-molecule drugs such as carbidopa and levodopa, alongside biosimilars in oncology and other therapeutic areas.

manufacturing_supply_model_pharma.label: Manufacturing / supply model [pharma]
manufacturing_supply_model_pharma.value: Global in-house drug manufacturing with vertically integrated API operations, industry supply partnerships, and AvKARE distribution to federal, retail, and institutional markets.

notes: Patent and exclusivity dependence and the level of R&D spending remain unclear.
